description: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
vibe: Monorepo discipline: virtualenvs, scoped AGENTS.md files, and never leak a customer slug into git history.
highlights: AGENTS.md files are declared the single source of truth for AI agent instructions, explicitly forbidding duplication into CLAUDE.md or Cursor rules.
Context-aware loading routes agents to the correct AGENTS.md based on file path (backend, tests, frontend), preventing cross-cutting confusion.
Hard rule against customer information in PRs, commits, or code, with prescribed synthetic placeholders like org-slug and user@example.com.
Frontend and backend are not atomically deployed, so mixed changes must be split into separate PRs with backend landing first.
Skills under .agents/skills/ are the home for workflow steering, keeping long guidance out of editor-specific rule files.
assessment: This file reflects mature monorepo hygiene: it treats agent instructions as versioned, scoped artifacts rather than a single dumping ground, and it encodes deployment reality (non-atomic frontend/backend) directly into PR rules. The customer-data prohibition is a rare and valuable anti-slop constraint that protects public git history, and the insistence on running pytest in the virtualenv with specific flags shows hard-won operational knowledge. The result is guidance that is specific, enforceable, and resistant to the usual AI-agent drift toward generic advice.
